name: DB74 全點位 → InfluxDB (plc_points)
func:
// =============================================
// DB74 全點位模擬 → InfluxDB
// tag_code 完全依照 plc_points 表
// 到現場時：刪除模擬區塊，改用 var plc = msg.payload
// =============================================

var r = Math.random;
var power = 500 + r() * 1000;
var flow = power / 500 - 0.2 + r() * 0.4;

var plc = {
    // === Byte 0: DN1350 閥 ===
    "VALVE_DN1350_CMD_OPEN":    0,
    "VALVE_DN1350_CMD_CLOSE":   0,
    "VALVE_DN1350_FB_OPEN":     r() > 0.3 ? 1 : 0,
    "VALVE_DN1350_FB_CLOSE":    r() > 0.7 ? 1 : 0,
    "VALVE_DN1350_REMOTE":      1,
    "VALVE_DN1350_CMD_ALARM":   0,
    "VALVE_DN1350_SPARE_1":     0,
    "VALVE_DN1350_SPARE_2":     0,

    // === Byte 1: DN1400 進水 ===
    "VALVE_DN1400_IN_CMD_OPEN":       1,
    "VALVE_DN1400_IN_CMD_CLOSE":      0,
    "VALVE_DN1400_FB_OPEN":           1,
    "VALVE_DN1400_FB_CLOSE":          0,
    "VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_CMD_OPEN":  0,
    "VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_CMD_CLOSE": 0,
    "VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_FB_OPEN":   0,
    "VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_FB_CLOSE":  1,

    // === Byte 2: DN1400 尾水 ===
    "VALVE_DN1400_OUT_CMD_OPEN":       1,
    "VALVE_DN1400_OUT_CMD_CLOSE":      0,
    "VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FB_OPEN":        1,
    "VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FB_CLOSE":       0,
    "VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_CMD_OPEN":  0,
    "VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_CMD_CLOSE": 0,
    "VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_FB_OPEN":   0,
    "VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_FB_CLOSE":  1,

    // === Byte 3: DN900 ===
    "VALVE_DN900_CMD_OPEN":       1,
    "VALVE_DN900_CMD_CLOSE":      0,
    "VALVE_DN900_FB_OPEN":        1,
    "VALVE_DN900_FB_CLOSE":       0,
    "VALVE_DN900_FILL_CMD_OPEN":  0,
    "VALVE_DN900_FILL_CMD_CLOSE": 0,
    "VALVE_DN900_FILL_FB_OPEN":   0,
    "VALVE_DN900_FILL_FB_CLOSE":  1,

    // === Byte 4: HPU 液壓 ===
    "HPU_TURB_MOTOR":          1,
    "HPU_TURB_QSD_VALVE":      0,
    "HPU_TURB_BRAKE":          0,
    "VALVE_DN900_STS":         0,
    "VALVE_DN1400_STS":        0,
    "HPU_BYPASS_MOTOR":        1,
    "HPU_BYPASS_CIRC_VALVE":   0,
    "HPU_BYPASS_DN1400_VALVE": 0,

    // === Byte 5: 旁通 + 系統告警 + 洩壓閥 ===
    "VALVE_DN1800_QSD":        0,
    "VALVE_DN1800_CLOSE":      0,
    "VALVE_DN1800_OPEN":       0,
    "SYS_UPS_ALARM":           0,
    "SYS_SHUTDOWN_ALARM":      0,
    "VALVE_OPV_FB_OPEN":       r() > 0.8 ? 1 : 0,
    "VALVE_OPV_FB_CLOSE":      r() > 0.2 ? 1 : 0,
    "VALVE_OPV_ALARM":         0,

    // === Byte 6: Int ===
    "TURB_GUIDE_VANE_RAW":     Math.round(r() * 27648),

    // === Byte 8+: Real ===
    "TURB_GUIDE_VANE":         Math.round(r() * 100 * 10) / 10,
    "TURB_FLOW_IN":            Math.round(flow * 100) / 100,
    "ENV_WATER_IN":            Math.round((2 + r() * 4) * 100) / 100,
    "ENV_WATER_OUT":           Math.round((1 + r() * 4) * 100) / 100,
    "TURB_PRESS_BEFORE":       Math.round((4 + r() * 4) * 100) / 100,
    "TURB_PRESS_AFTER":        Math.round((3 + r() * 4) * 100) / 100,
    "GEN_POWER_P":             Math.round(power * 100) / 100,
    "GEN_POWER_Q":             Math.round((-200 + r() * 400) * 100) / 100,
    "GEN_POWER_S":             Math.round(power * 1.05 * 100) / 100,
    "HPU_PRESS_TURB1":         Math.round((80 + r() * 100) * 10) / 10,
    "HPU_PRESS_BYPASS2":       Math.round((100 + r() * 200) * 10) / 10,
    "GEN_TEMP_U":              Math.round((50 + r() * 45) * 10) / 10,
    "GEN_TEMP_V":              Math.round((50 + r() * 45) * 10) / 10,
    "GEN_TEMP_W":              Math.round((50 + r() * 45) * 10) / 10,
    "GEN_BEAR_TEMP_DE":        Math.round((30 + r() * 30) * 10) / 10,
    "GEN_BEAR_TEMP_NDE":       Math.round((30 + r() * 30) * 10) / 10,
    "GEN_VIB_DE":              Math.round((0.2 + r() * 1.3) * 100) / 100,
    "GEN_VIB_NDE":             Math.round((0.2 + r() * 1.3) * 100) / 100,
    "GEN_SPEED_PCT":           Math.round((90 + r() * 15) * 10) / 10,
    "GEN_SPEED":               Math.round(340 + r() * 40),
    "ELEC_CURR_L1":            Math.round((-500 + r() * 1000) * 10) / 10,
    "ELEC_CURR_L2":            Math.round((-500 + r() * 1000) * 10) / 10,
    "ELEC_CURR_L3":            Math.round((-500 + r() * 1000) * 10) / 10,
    "ELEC_CURR_L1P":           Math.round((-800 + r() * 1600) * 10) / 10,
    "ELEC_CURR_L2P":           Math.round((-800 + r() * 1600) * 10) / 10,
    "ELEC_CURR_L3P":           Math.round((-800 + r() * 1600) * 10) / 10,
    "ELEC_VOLT_AB":            Math.round((380 + r() * 40) * 10) / 10,
    "ELEC_VOLT_BC":            Math.round((380 + r() * 40) * 10) / 10,
    "ELEC_VOLT_CA":            Math.round((380 + r() * 40) * 10) / 10,
    "CTRL_TEMP":               Math.round((20 + r() * 20) * 10) / 10,
    "GEN_TEMP_ENV":            Math.round((20 + r() * 15) * 10) / 10,
    "ENV_NOISE_IN":            Math.round((50 + r() * 50) * 10) / 10,
    "ENV_NOISE_OUT":           Math.round((50 + r() * 50) * 10) / 10,
    "CALC_FLOW_PLUNGER":       Math.round(r() * 5 * 100) / 100,
    "CALC_FLOW_TURBINE":       Math.round(flow * 100) / 100,
    "CALC_FLOW_TOTAL":         Math.round((flow + r() * 2) * 100) / 100,
    "VALVE_DN1350_PRESS_IN":   Math.round((5 + r() * 8) * 100) / 100,
    "VALVE_DN1350_PRESS_OUT":  Math.round((3 + r() * 6) * 100) / 100,
    "VALVE_OPV_PRESS_WATER":   Math.round((5 + r() * 15) * 100) / 100,
    "VALVE_OPV_PRESS_HYD":     Math.round((30 + r() * 100) * 10) / 10,

    // === 非 DB74，但 homepage 需要 ===
    "VALVE_DN1350_PCT":        Math.round(r() * 100 * 10) / 10
};

// device_code 依照 plc_points 表
var deviceMap = {
    VALVE_DN1350_CMD_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN1350_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_FB_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN1350_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_REMOTE: "valve", VALVE_DN1350_CMD_ALARM: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_SPARE_1: "valve", VALVE_DN1350_SPARE_2: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_CMD_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN1400_IN_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_FB_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN1400_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_CMD_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_FB_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN1400_IN_FILL_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_CMD_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN1400_OUT_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FB_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_CMD_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_FB_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN1400_OUT_FILL_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_CMD_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN900_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FB_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN900_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FILL_CMD_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN900_FILL_CMD_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_FILL_FB_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_DN900_FILL_FB_CLOSE: "valve",
    VALVE_DN900_STS: "valve", VALVE_DN1400_STS: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1800_QSD: "valve", VALVE_DN1800_CLOSE: "valve", VALVE_DN1800_OPEN: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_FB_OPEN: "valve", VALVE_OPV_FB_CLOSE: "valve", VALVE_OPV_ALARM: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_PRESS_IN: "valve", VALVE_DN1350_PRESS_OUT: "valve",
    VALVE_OPV_PRESS_WATER: "valve", VALVE_OPV_PRESS_HYD: "valve",
    VALVE_DN1350_PCT: "valve",
    HPU_TURB_MOTOR: "hpu", HPU_TURB_QSD_VALVE: "hpu", HPU_TURB_BRAKE: "hpu",
    HPU_BYPASS_MOTOR: "hpu", HPU_BYPASS_CIRC_VALVE: "hpu", HPU_BYPASS_DN1400_VALVE: "hpu",
    HPU_PRESS_TURB1: "hpu", HPU_PRESS_BYPASS2: "hpu",
    SYS_UPS_ALARM: "control", SYS_SHUTDOWN_ALARM: "control", CTRL_TEMP: "control",
    TURB_GUIDE_VANE_RAW: "turbine", TURB_GUIDE_VANE: "turbine",
    TURB_FLOW_IN: "turbine", TURB_PRESS_BEFORE: "turbine", TURB_PRESS_AFTER: "turbine",
    CALC_FLOW_PLUNGER: "turbine", CALC_FLOW_TURBINE: "turbine",
    CALC_FLOW_TOTAL: "general",
    GEN_POWER_P: "generator", GEN_POWER_Q: "generator", GEN_POWER_S: "generator",
    GEN_TEMP_U: "generator", GEN_TEMP_V: "generator", GEN_TEMP_W: "generator",
    GEN_BEAR_TEMP_DE: "generator", GEN_BEAR_TEMP_NDE: "generator",
    GEN_VIB_DE: "generator", GEN_VIB_NDE: "generator",
    GEN_SPEED_PCT: "generator", GEN_SPEED: "generator", GEN_TEMP_ENV: "generator",
    ELEC_CURR_L1: "electrical", ELEC_CURR_L2: "electrical", ELEC_CURR_L3: "electrical",
    ELEC_CURR_L1P: "electrical", ELEC_CURR_L2P: "electrical", ELEC_CURR_L3P: "electrical",
    ELEC_VOLT_AB: "electrical", ELEC_VOLT_BC: "electrical", ELEC_VOLT_CA: "electrical",
    ENV_WATER_IN: "environment", ENV_WATER_OUT: "environment",
    ENV_NOISE_IN: "environment", ENV_NOISE_OUT: "environment"
};

var lines = [];
for (var tag in plc) {
    var device = deviceMap[tag] || "unknown";
    var val = plc[tag];
    lines.push("measurements,plant_id=hushan,tag_code=" + tag + ",device_code=" + device + " value=" + val);
}

msg.payload = lines.join("\n");
msg.headers = {
    "Authorization": "Token UrXPX5bskMb-AwIKOm7k7AuLPVuxiSaIUd943uhHwrZcg2gbI4K7fsfWWMqyxTqJi5iFpGNstKQvHwmdkxxGfQ==",
    "Content-Type": "text/plain"
};
msg.url = "http://192.168.14.203:8086/api/v2/write?org=SCADA_hushan&bucket=demo_realtime&precision=ms";
return msg;
